content.rendered:
Our office will be closed for the summer June 20th-August 16th. For urgent assistance, please visit our District Office, located at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd. District Office is open Monday-Thursday, 7:30-4:00.

Registration is now online. If you need to register a new student or a previously withdrawn student who is returning to our district, please follow this link for online registration information. You may also contact the District Office at 503-825-5000 for assistance if needed.
